key_insight: Tandem Reinforcement Learning (TRL) adapts RL with verifiable rewards so a stronger model learns reasoning that a weaker partner can follow, without sacrificing solo performance.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical training strategy for multi-model systems and human-facing AI where reasoning quality and communication clarity both matter.
method: Alternate a senior and frozen junior stochastically during rollout generation.
Reward the joint chain-of-thought as a team, then apply standard GRPO loss to the senior.
Use the tandem rollout structure to encourage robust handoffs and more legible reasoning.
evidence_signal: On Qwen3-4B-Instruct for competition math, TRL matched vanilla GRPO on solo reasoning while improving junior handoff robustness, reducing distributional drift, and increasing legibility to the junior.
watch_item: The approach was demonstrated on competition-math RLVR with a specific model setup, so broader gains and training stability across tasks and larger systems still need validation.
paper_title: Tandem Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
